gen-flavors-gf-inter-tight: Chunky and cheeky, with a lowercase that towers. Flavors shouts through its tall, uniformly heavy strokes, while Inter Tight, short in the ascenders with tails held back, stays tucked and tidy beneath it.
gen-flavors-gf-krub: Krub reads brisk and slightly unfinished, its curves lifting off before the loop closes, a plain sans with a pronounced x-height. Flavors, cut from one gauge of tubing, gives it a loud partner.
gen-flavors-gf-lexend: Lexend has a plain sans lowercase of outsized proportions, with open jaws on every curved stroke. And Flavors, whose diagonals carry the heft of its stems, supplies the shout up top.
gen-flavors-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Flavors brings whimsical, commanding diagonals as hefty as its stems, with a stubby, towering x-height. But Mochiy Pop One, a sans with an oversized lowercase eye, hangs its letters like clothespins.
gen-flavors-gf-nobile: Nobile is a plain sans whose lowercase nearly meets its capitals. Beside it, Flavors drops every hairline and swell, so its towering, pencil-stub letters and those open mouths feel cut from different but friendly cloth.
gen-flavors-gf-nokora: Whimsical Flavors has no hairlines to squint at, just stout diagonals. Nokora, a sans with a wide-open s, lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase down every line, steady paragraph after paragraph.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans: Commanding and whimsical, Flavors uses one unvarying stroke and a towering lowercase. Noto Sans, a sans with a wide-open c and lowercase filling most of the letter height, keeps the page easygoing.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hiero: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs points its terminals outward, a plain sans with modern manners. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs lifts its x-height near cap height, while Flavors holds a hairline-free, stubby loudness.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Flavors never thins at the shoulders, and its lowercase towers. Noto Sans Armenian, a sans with a wide, inviting opening on its round letters, lets the loudness settle into something approachable.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Flavors hums along at a flat, constant line weight. Noto Sans Balinese, a plain sans with breathing space inside every curve and short ascenders, gives that hum somewhere quiet to rest.
